name: St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort
positioning: The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort: a private-island resort on Vommuli Island in Dhaalu Atoll, with manta-ray-shaped overwater villas and an overwater spa
best_for: Divers and snorkelers who want a house reef and over 40 dive sites around the atoll
Families wanting a supervised kids club and bicycles at every villa

facts.text: The resort is on a private island surrounded by rainforest and white-sand beaches, overlooking the Indian Ocean.
The resort is on Vommuli Island in Dhaalu Atoll, Maldives.
The resort's library is shaped to swirl upward like a cone shell.
T-Pan serves modern Japanese kaiseki with limited seating, paired with Dassai sakes.
Decanter is a hidden wine cellar offering a fine-dining six-course menu with hand-picked vintages.
The Whale Bar serves Latin-inspired tapas and cocktails at sunset, with a signature Champagne Sabering ritual.
The Blue Hole Pool is a hydrotherapy pool with whirlpool jets on the spa's covered terrace.
The dive and watersports centre reaches over 40 dive sites around the atoll, and the house reef is good for snorkeling.
Bicycles are provided for every villa.
The complimentary Children's Club is monitored at all times by professional childcare attendants.
Garden Villas sit within the island's jungle canopy and each has a private pool.
The John Jacob Astor Estate has a cinema room, a private gym and a dedicated space for spa treatments.

highlights.text: Overwater villas are shaped like manta rays and built mainly from cross laminated wood instead of traditional thatch.
The Whale Bar sits over the Indian Ocean and is shaped to resemble a whale shark.
Visits to the overwater Iridium Spa begin in the Iridium Room, where guests sip Iridium tea while watching marine life through glass floors.
Norma, the resort's private yacht, was inspired by Nourmahal, the yacht of John Jacob Astor IV, and is designed for up to eight guests.
The resort has partnered with Reefscapers on coral reef restoration since 2023.

considerations.text: Resort transfers are mandatory: a round-trip shared seaplane transfer of about 45 minutes from the airport.
Guests on flights arriving after 3:30 PM must stay overnight in Male.
The resort is not technically wheelchair accessible, though it takes steps to make stays as easy as possible.
